title: Shortest Word Distance
summary: Given an array of strings wordsDict and two distinct strings word1 and word2 present in the array, return the minimum distance between these two words within the array.
statement: Given an array of strings wordsDict and two distinct strings word1 and word2 present in the array, return the minimum distance between these two words within the array.
constraints: words contains 2–30000 lowercase words of length 1–10. word1 and word2 are distinct and both occur in words.
Return the minimum absolute difference between an occurrence index of word1 and an occurrence index of word2.
hints: The closest pair involving the current occurrence uses the most recent occurrence of the other word.
Track the latest index of each target while scanning once.
After either index changes, update the best absolute gap when both have been seen.
Do not stop at the first pair; later occurrences can be closer.
editorial: For any current target occurrence, older occurrences of the other target are farther away than its latest occurrence. Tracking two latest indices therefore considers every potentially optimal cross-pair in one pass. The independent oracle lists every occurrence and compares their Cartesian product.
